audit.why: Level 1 even, Cassiopeia from 2 through first item, Ryze back on two items — both layers agree and it matches a 59.09% Emerald+ rate over 88 games. Ryze genuinely out-scales her once Archangel's into Seraph's lands, and she genuinely owns the window before it. No stage side needed changing.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike says only "stand facing him as he steps up to Rune Prison you" with no cooldown, so there is no way to tell what a dodged Rune Prison buys.
audit.why: Rune Prison is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9 and Spell Flux 3.5s. Dodging the Flux is what makes the W harmless, and the W is an 11-second window at rank 1 — those two numbers are the whole trade clock.
audit.corrected: 11s and 615 written into spikes[1].text, spikes[2].text, whys[3] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things. (a) mid and spikes[2].text tell you to "weave around his short ~565 cast range". Ryze has no 565-range ability: Rune Prison and Spell Flux are 615 and Overload is 1000, which outranges your own 850 Noxious Blast. Advice built on a range that does not exist will get a reader poked out. (b) The decisive interaction is never stated: Rune Prison only roots if the target already has Flux on them, otherwise it is a slow. Sidestepping Spell Flux downgrades his lockdown to nothing.
audit.why: Riot: Rune Prison — "traps a target in a cage of runes, damaging them and slowing their movement. If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted." Overload range 1000, Rune Prison and Spell Flux range 615. There is no 565-range ability in the kit.
audit.corrected: The 565 figure replaced with the real 615 and 1000, and the Flux-gates-the-root rule written into spikes[1].text, spikes[2].text, wants.foe[0], whys[3] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: "Twin Fangs" plural in spikes[2].text and mid. wants.you[0] also claims grounding kills Realm Warp.
audit.why: The ability is Twin Fang. Grounding disables movement abilities and Flash; whether it stops Realm Warp being cast is not something Riot's text answers, so the claim was narrowed to Flash rather than dropped or guessed at.
audit.corrected: Plural fixed; the Realm Warp claim narrowed to Flash in wants.you[0] and mid.

edits.before: Petrifying Gaze beats his all-in: stand facing him as he steps up to Rune Prison you, and the frontal stun locks him before he can land W into Overload — a won poke trade becomes a kill.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze beats his all-in: face him as he steps up to Rune Prison you and the frontal stun lands first — and with no Flux on you that W is an 11s slow, not a root, so you walk out.

edits.before: Malignance into a poisoned target plus your Serpentine Grace move speed lets you weave around his ~565 cast range and fire Twin Fangs faster than his mana pool can sustain his Overload resets.
edits.after: Malignance into a poisoned target plus Serpentine Grace lets you sidestep Spell Flux at 615 and fire Twin Fang faster than his mana sustains Overload resets — and no Flux means Rune Prison only slows.

edits.before: Drop Miasma (W) on him to ground him so Realm Warp and Flash are dead, then ramp Twin Fang while he's stuck in your poison cloud
edits.after: Drop Miasma (W) on him — he has no dash, but grounding still denies Flash, so ramp Twin Fang while he is stuck in the poison

edits.before: Land Rune Prison (W) to root you, then Overload plus Spell Flux to poke and proc his cooldown resets from max range
edits.after: Land Spell Flux (E) first so Rune Prison roots instead of slowing, then Overload from 1000 range on its reset

edits.before: Ranks in Q and E let you spam Twin Fang and weave around his short cast range while he burns mana on resets that you simply walk out of.
edits.after: Ranks in Q and E let you spam Twin Fang outside Spell Flux's 615 range, so Rune Prison never roots and he burns mana on resets you walk out of.

edits.before: This is your lane. Ranks in Q and E let you chain near-continuous Twin Fangs, and Serpentine Grace move speed plus the Noxious Blast speed buff mean you weave around his short ~565 cast range while he burns mana on Overload resets. Drop Miasma (W) on him to ground him — Ryze has no dash, so this mainly locks down his Realm Warp and Flash escapes and pins him in your poison while you ramp E. At 6, hold Petrifying Gaze for the moment he steps up to start his W-into-Overload combo: face him and the stun cancels it into a kill.
edits.after: This is your lane. Ranks in Q and E let you chain near-continuous Twin Fang, and Serpentine Grace plus the Noxious Blast speed buff mean you live outside Spell Flux's 615 range while he burns mana on Overload resets — with no Flux on you, Rune Prison is a slow, not a root. Don't stand still for Overload, which reaches 1000. Drop Miasma on him and grounding still denies his Flash even though he has no dash. At 6, hold Petrifying Gaze for his step-up: face him and the stun ends the combo.

notes: Whether Grounded prevents casting Realm Warp is not answerable from Riot's text, so I narrowed that claim to Flash rather than assert it. Separate champion-level issue seen across several Cassiopeia entries including this one's whys[5]: text describes Serpentine Grace as converting move speed "to AP" or as a "no-boots passive". Serpentine Grace only amplifies move speed bonuses — it grants no AP and does not stop her buying boots.
